Hi,

To resolve the issue of emails stuck in your Outbox on your laptop, please follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar in Outlook. If it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.
2. Close Outlook completely and then start it again.
3. Open Outlook on the web at outlook.office.com to check if email works there. If it does, the problem is with the desktop app.
4. Repair your Outlook profile by going to Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Repair.
5. Clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.

If the problem persists or if Outlook on the web also fails, please escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support.

Thank you for your patience!

Hello,

Thank you for reaching out about your slow laptop. To help improve its performance, please follow these steps:

1. Restart your laptop completely; do not just close the lid.
2. Install any pending updates by going to Settings > Windows Update, then restart your laptop again.
3. Run Disk Cleanup to delete temporary files and consider moving large personal files to OneDrive.
4. Close any unnecessary applications that start automatically by using Task Manager > Startup.

If your laptop remains slow after these steps, please let us know so we can assist further.

Best regards,
IT Service Desk

Hi,

To reset your forgotten password, please follow these steps:
1. Go to the self-service password reset page at passwordreset.aurora-retail.example.
2. Verify your identity using the authenticator app or your registered phone.
3. Choose a new password that is at least 14 characters long and that you have not used before.
4. After resetting, sign out of all applications and sign in again with your new password. Don't forget to update it on your phone's email app as well.

If you cannot verify your identity during this process, please let us know so we can escalate to Identity & Access Management for further assistance.

Best regards,
Support Team

To resolve your VPN disconnecting issue, please try the following steps:
1. Test your home internet connection without the VPN, for example by running a speed test. If the connection is slow, restart your home router.
2. Use a wired connection or move closer to your Wi-Fi router to improve signal strength.
3. Disconnect and reconnect the VPN, making sure to select the nearest gateway.
4. Update your VPN client from the Company Portal to ensure you have the latest version.
5. Avoid large uploads or streaming while connected to the VPN, as these can affect stability.
If your VPN connection still drops more than three times an hour on a good home connection, please escalate the issue to Network & Remote Access for further assistance.

To find your payslip in Workday, please follow these steps:
1. Sign in to Workday through the single sign-on portal.
2. Open the Pay application and select Payslips.
This will allow you to view your payslips directly in the Workday HR portal.

Hi, to resolve the no sound issue in Teams meetings on your laptop, please follow these steps:
1. In Teams, open Settings > Devices and select the correct speaker, microphone, and camera.
2. Make a test call from Settings > Devices > Make a test call.
3. Close other applications that may use the camera or microphone.
4. Unplug and reconnect the headset or docking station, then restart Teams.
5. Check the Windows privacy settings: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and Camera must allow Teams.
If the problem continues after restarting your laptop, please let us know so we can escalate this to Messaging & Collaboration Support for further assistance. Thank you!

To resolve the printer offline issue, please follow these steps:
1. Check that the printer is switched on and has paper and toner.
2. Remove any stuck jobs from the print queue and try printing again.
3. Remove the printer in Settings > Printers and add it again from the Company Portal.
4. Try printing to another printer to determine if the problem is with your laptop or the printer.
If the printer itself shows an error, please escalate to End-User Computing for further assistance.

To resolve the slowness and session expiration issue in Fiori, please follow these steps:
1. Close any unused SAP sessions and browser tabs with Fiori apps.
2. Clear your browser cache and sign in to the Fiori launchpad again.
3. Try using the same transaction in another browser.
4. Note the time, transaction, and confirm if other users are affected.
If the problem persists or affects multiple users, please let us know so we can escalate to ERP Finance Support.
Your issue is resolved

To resolve the issue with your second monitor not being detected on the docking station, please follow these steps:
1. Disconnect and reconnect the docking station cable to your laptop.
2. Ensure that the monitor is switched on and set to the correct input.
3. Press Windows + P on your keyboard and select Extend.
4. Restart your laptop while it is connected to the docking station.
If the monitor or docking station still appears faulty after these steps, please let us know so we can escalate the issue to End-User Computing for further assistance.
